svg.text: Read each lane left to right. Green = data is safe/durable at that point, red = failure or guard path, dashed arrow = alternative path.
1. Startup and first-launch storage migration (per device)
5. Reports (server SQL, one RPC per screen)
6. Monthly archive and retention (admin, no cron)
Conflict rule: financial rows (invoice, invoice_item, payment, expense, ledger, daily_closing) with an older version from another device -> CONFLICT, nothing written, shown in Settings → Conflicts.
Same device sending an older copy (late retry) -> SUPERSEDED (acked). Catalog rows (customers, products, rooms, tables…) -> last writer wins by version, then updated_at.
Two devices closing the same day: latest CLOSED row wins, the other points to it via superseded_by (never deleted). Bad legacy totals are imported as-is and flagged (legacy_mismatch).
